  "memo":"Only R03 holds, establishing the Card family. Account access, Velocity, Linkage and Context conditions do not hold; no household exception is needed. No earlier outcome settles the order. The underlying decision-table row is §6.6(b), but the failed id_check now decides under §5.3(b): decline is standard, and escalation is prohibited without Linkage. The established device, home delivery and paid installment history offer a benign explanation but do not override failed verification or establish the current orderer's identity. Recommend decline before shipment; no additional check is needed."
